type Broad = { kind: 'item'; value: string } | object;
const mismatch: Broad = { kind: 'item', value: 1 };
const extra: Broad = { arbitrary: 2 };
function consume(value: Broad): Broad { return value; }
function create(): Broad { return { kind: 'item', value: 3 }; }
console.log(mismatch, extra, consume({ more: true }), create());
